load_fasttext_model: load a binarized fastText model from a given file path
load_pth_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from a PyTorch .pth binary file
load_bin_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from a fastText .bin binary file
load_embeddings: load and normalize pretrained embeddings for source or target language
prune_embeddings: prune a dictionary and embeddings tensor to a maximum vocabulary size
